_doc: The Castle's unique units (milestone 13 step 4): one per race, a theme chosen by race_generator.gd _unique_theme: the theme whose `asked` tags the prompt asked for most (romans -> testudo, cheese -> big_cheese, even for frogs), else the creature's `unique` (creatures.json), else its culture's (families.json). A theme: `role` (which weapon it needs, as that line's: infantry = a blade or club, spear, archer = a bow, skirmisher = non-bow ranged), `parts` (its signature kit, taken first where the age and era allow; hand_r first), `wants` (tags its other gear leans to), `mount` "ride" (on the race's mount, if it has one), `giant` (a giant, where the creature reads well giant), `light` (no heavy kit: the raiders), `stats` (added on top: hp, attack, speed, range, sight in tiles, armour, reload in ticks), `bonus` (attack bonus by class), `price_points` (what the stats and bonus add to its price; the cost curve does the rest), `noun` (its name; the creature's noun goes first unless it's folk or one of the theme's `own` creatures), `desc` (one line for the tech tree page and the card). No new parts: each theme is a distinctive combination of existing ones; the parts each would want are listed in docs/milestones/m13-unit-lines.md (concept-first, D-080).

testudo.desc: Locked shields: shrugs off arrows (+3 pierce armour); slow, and swords still cut it

phalanx.desc: A wall of bronze spears: holds riders and swordsmen (+2 melee armour); arrows still find it

sworn_knight.desc: A knight on foot in iron and mail: very hard to kill (+20 HP); slow

steppe_raider.desc: A fast, light rider for raids: workers, healers, engines and buildings; spears and archers stop it

gutter_raider.desc: Quick, light raiders out of the drains: workers, healers, engines and buildings; any real soldier beats them

big_cheese.desc: The biggest hammer of cheese, in tin armour: breaks buildings and lines (+20 HP); slow, and archers wear it down

bullfrog.desc: A giant bullfrog that flattens foot soldiers (bonus vs infantry); spears bring it down

web_lurker.desc: A quick spitter that waits in the brush for riders and beasts (bonus vs large, +3 sight); swordsmen chase it off

stag_colossus.desc: A giant stag beetle in bark plates: shrugs off blows (+2 melee armour); spears bring it down

nile_bowguard.desc: Picked archers of the river: shoot further (+1 range, +1 pierce armour); skirmishers and riders catch them

repeater.desc: A crossbow with a magazine: light bolts, very fast; armour soaks them, skirmishers beat them

obsidian.desc: A fast champion with an obsidian-edged club: cuts down foot soldiers (bonus vs infantry); archers wear it down

horned_raider.desc: Light, quick raiders off the boats: hit hard, burn buildings, chase workers; archers and riders beat them

bog_lurker.desc: Quick blowgunners in leaf cloaks: see far, sting foot soldiers (+2 sight, bonus vs infantry); riders run them down

moss_warden.desc: Woodland archers who see and shoot further (+1 range, +3 sight); skirmishers and riders catch them

scrap_brute.desc: A bruiser in riveted junk: breaks buildings and soaks blows (+15 HP); archers wear it down

gloom_stalker.desc: Quick things from the dark: fall on archers, healers and workers (+2 sight); spears and real soldiers beat them
